content.title: Wrongful Death - The Cochran Firm Memphis
content.text: Experienced Wrongful Death AttorneysThe death of a loved one is one of the most devastating parts of life. When that death is caused by the negligence of another party, the pain can be even more unbearable. At The Cochran Firm of the Mid-South, we represent families who have lost a loved one due to the fault of another person or a company. These cases are known as wrongful death cases. We have a Memphis wrongful death lawyer ready to fight for you.These cases can be extremely painful for those left behind. The family of the deceased deserves justice for the death of their loved one. Also, they deserve to be compensated by the responsible party.It is imperative that the family members select a Mid-South or Memphis wrongful death attorney who has the experience and skill necessary to bring litigation in full force. Although emotions may be high, the family should diligently select the lawyer they feel can provide the greatest opportunity for winning the lawsuit. We invite you to contact a Memphis wrongful death lawyer on The Cochran Firm of the Mid-South team today for a free case evaluation.Statute of LimitationsThe Tennessee and Arkansas statute of limitations to file a lawsuit for wrongful death is only one year from the date of the incident. This means you must act quickly to hire a wrongful death attorney to represent you or you may lose all rights to a settlement even if you are very likely to win.In Mississippi, the claim must be filed within three years of the date of death.Accidental DeathVery few deaths are truly accidental. In fact, most accidental deaths are a result of a chain of events that proper planning, equipment, or diligence would have prevented. Our accidental death lawyers have found that in many cases, the warning signs were overlooked or ignored. If someone had taken the proper precautions, then the tragic death could have been prevented. Above all, our accidental death lawyers and attorneys are ready to demand that every person responsible for the accidental death be held accountable.The Cochran Firm of the Mid-South wrongful death attorneys believe that:• You, as a victim of wrongful death and negligence, have a right to forceful legal representation.• Responsible parties should be held accountable for the death.• Corporations and municipal entities are not above the law.• Your status, origin, and income should not weaken your power in court.Contact the Cochran Firm of the Mid-South TodayAt The Cochran Firm of the Mid-South, we are ready to take cases in the states of Tennessee, Arkansas, and Mississippi. If you or a loved one has been a victim wrongful death, contact us to help you get the justice you deserve.COCHRAN FIRM MID-SOUTH40 South Main, Suite 1700Memphis, TN 38103Managing AttorneyHoward Manis
